# Native select

The browser's own select, styled.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-native-select--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Native select examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-native-select--docs">Open Native select in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-native-select--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** A plain closed list such as country on a phone, where the system picker is best. Not where options need rich content.

- **Use it when:** A plain closed list, especially on phones, where the system picker is best.
- **Not when:** Options that need icons or rich content (select), or a short list better shown at once (radio group).

Instead:

- [Select](./select.md): A custom menu with richer options.
- [Radio group](./radio-group.md): A short list shown at once.

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add native-select
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Native select reads 22 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Native select's tokens to change Native select alone.
